name: Balir Frosthammer
summary: In Coldridge Valley, Balir Frosthammer rallies recruits against the Rockjaw troggs. The dwarf guards Dun Morogh as the troggs press into dwarven lands.

sections.title: Holding Coldridge Valley
sections.body: Balir Frosthammer calls new recruits to defend Coldridge Valley. Dwarven and gnomish novices have long found safety and training there, but trouble underground has driven violent Rockjaw troggs to the surface. Balir is among the first to raise the alarm. He urges recruits to thin their numbers before they push farther into Dun Morogh.

sections.title: Kin of the Frosthammers
sections.body: Balir Frosthammer bears a name shared with Tannok Frosthammer of Kharanos. The two may belong to the same family, whose members stand by Ironforge. They help keep the cold mountain passes safe for travelers, miners, and mountaineers as threats grow across the region.

faq.answer: Balir Frosthammer guards Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh. He calls on incoming recruits to thin the hostile Rockjaw troggs threatening the valley's defenses.

faq.q: Why is Balir concerned about the troggs?
faq.answer: Rockjaw troggs have recently surfaced in force, disturbing Coldridge Valley and attacking dwarven settlements. Balir sees a growing danger that must be contained early.

faq.q: Is Balir related to Tannok Frosthammer?
faq.answer: Possibly. Balir shares the Frosthammer name with Tannok Frosthammer of Kharanos, which suggests a family connection, though none is confirmed.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can help Balir Frosthammer defend your homeland from threats rising underground. His call offers an early chance to protect Dun Morogh.
As an Alliance recruit, you train in Khaz Modan, and Balir works to keep Coldridge Valley secure as a staging ground.
